reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 3 points better, in a game of about 220 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Magic.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 53 times in 100; most games like this end between 190 and 239 total points.

analyst.text: Detroit have lost three straight after blowing an 11-point fourth-quarter lead in Atlanta (outscored 33-12), and Cade Cunningham is playing through right-knee soreness after a 5-point night; he is listed probable. Orlando were routed 116-96 at home by Washington but are chasing a 4-0 NBA Cup group mark, and Sean Sweeney wants his close-outs fixed. Both teams are stung, but Detroit's late-game wobble and a sore star lean this one slightly Orlando.
